summary: A legal-heavy morning dominated by tax and IP rulings, with retail sector moves and Reliance-backed fund commentary. Bombay High Court clarifies digital movie delivery tax treatment; Delhi High Court rules on pharma tax dispute; FMCG distributors escalate UPI-MDR demands to PM.

bullets.text: Bombay High Court: movies delivered via digital link or hard disk do not qualify as IT software for tax purposes.
Delhi High Court: Israeli pharma firm Teva Israel wins tax battle against Income Tax Department.
FMCG distributors petition PM seeking zero merchant discount rate on UPI transactions, citing cascading tax incidence.
JioBlackRock CIO: largecap valuations de-rated; Indian banks underperformed global peers, signalling potential market leadership shift.
Fujifilm investing ₹800 crore in semiconductor materials plant at Dholera Special Investment Region; partnering Tata Electronics.
